chunks: And Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:
Concerning the one who has intercourse with a woman while she is dead, he said: “His sin is greater than that of the one who has intercourse with her while she is alive.”
ai.seo_question: What does Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām say about intercourse with a deceased woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal-moral ruling regarding intercourse with a deceased woman and states that its burden of sin is even greater than illicit intercourse with her while alive. It underscores the gravity of violating sanctity and the severe prohibition of such an act in Shia fiqh.
